desc: Lifts small conch to lips, leans back, blows it like a horn

problems: At the peak (t≈1.1–2.1s) it reads correctly as blowing a conch: the narrow tip is at the lips, the bell points away and there are sound marks.

The sound-wave marks ')))' show in every frame, including t=0.0s and t=2.7s when the shell is down at the chest. It looks like he is already blowing at chest height, so the start and end don't read as a rest pose.
The conch is too big for a 'small conch'. Its body plus the coral-red bell is wider than the head (about 1.3× head width), so at the peak it hides the whole lower face and reads as heavy.

The start-to-end motion is weak. The rest pose already holds the shell high across the chest (near y=-250), so the lift to the mouth (y=-338/-342) is only about 90 units and the 'raise' beat barely registers.
The lean back is too faint (lean -0.2 at most). In the frames the torso stays almost upright, so the 'leans back and blows' accent is lost.
The bumps on top of the shell are small dots that look scattered and slightly detached at this size. They should read as part of the shell's spiral.

for: raise a conch shell to the lips and blow it like a horn
